newsitem.title: USA: Detroit Ed restores electricity to 385,000.
newsitem.headline: Detroit Ed restores electricity to 385,000.

text.p: Detroit Edison said Monday it has restored service to more than 385,000 electricity customers following last Thursday night's severe ice storm in southeastern Michigan.
About 37,000 customers are still without service, the company said in a statement, adding that the restoration effort will continue through Tuesday.
More than 422,000 out a total of more than two million Detroit Edison customers lost service late last week when falling ice brought down tree limbs and wires.
Nearly 65 crews from Illinois and Indiana utilities joined in the restoration effort.
Detroit Edison is a subsidiary of DTE Energy Co.
